objective: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.

description: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, <class>.
completion: So, you've returned so quickly, huh? And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?

Were you able to help a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Impressive, <name>, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.
Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
